pmcro.seed.purpose: start or continue an autonomous cycle

governance.audit.reference.purpose: reference tamper-evident governance/audit evidence without copying the external audit log

outcome.attestation.purpose: post-action verification of observed outcome linked to execution and governance evidence

executive.advice.purpose: bounded executive analysis/recommendation; no external side effect

executive.decision.purpose: bounded business decision with rationale, evidence state, and delegation recommendation

executive.delegation.purpose: delegate an approved business intent to a registered domain agent/capability

executive.review.purpose: review returned domain evidence against business objective and constraints

executive.escalation.purpose: escalate unresolved authority, risk, conflict, or human-required decision without inventing capability
